connector.name: three.ws Scenes
connector.registryDescription: Compose a placed 3D diorama from one sentence, export a forged world, browse saved scenes.
connector.summary: Runs locally from the npm package scene-mcp. No credential is declared, and it reaches 8 of 9 clients tracked here.
connector.provenanceNote: Published from the nirholas account, and the linked repository sits under the same account. Namespace ownership was proven at publish time.

env.name: THREE_WS_BASE
env.description: Base URL of the three.ws API that serves /api/diorama. Override only when self-hosting or targeting a preview deployment.

env.name: THREE_WS_TIMEOUT_MS
env.description: Per-request timeout in milliseconds. compose_scene runs a server-side LLM chain, so the default is generous.
